answer: A concrete way to resist sybil attacks is staked identity with slashing: every agent locks collateral, a jade token of sorts, before it may attest, so spawning fake identities costs real funds. Peer committees like a mature grove of high-reputation nodes cross-check each attestation, and voters who sign contradictions lose their stake. Trust then flows like a river toward long, honest histories, making mass fake identities expensive and self-defeating for an attacker.
